TileStructure.Forest.χtilde.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space equipped with the standing Carleson data $\mathrm{ProofData}(a, q, K, \sigma_1, \sigma_2, F, G)$ (with $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, a kernel $K : X \times X \to \mathbb{C}$, functions $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$ and sets $F, G \subseteq X$), and with a tile structure $\mathrm{TileStructure}(Q, \mathrm{defaultD}(a), \mathrm{default}\kappa(a), \mathrm{defaultS}(X), \mathrm{cancelPt}(X))$ on $X$, where $Q$ is the function $X \to \Theta(X)$ given by the proof data. Definition: for a cube $J \in \mathrm{Grid}(X)$, a tile $u_1 \in \mathfrak{P}(X)$ and a point $x \in X$, the nonnegative real number $\tilde\chi_J(u_1)(x)$; according to the docstring, this is the function $\tilde\chi$ defined in the proof of Lemma 7.5.2.

TileStructure.Forest.𝓙₅.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space equipped with the standing Carleson data $\mathrm{ProofData}(a, q, K, \sigma_1, \sigma_2, F, G)$ (with $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, a kernel $K : X \times X \to \mathbb{C}$, functions $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$ and sets $F, G \subseteq X$), and with a tile structure $\mathrm{TileStructure}(Q, \mathrm{defaultD}(a), \mathrm{default}\kappa(a), \mathrm{defaultS}(X), \mathrm{cancelPt}(X))$ on $X$, where $Q$ is the function $X \to \Theta(X)$ given by the proof data. Definition: for a natural number $n$, an $n$-forest $t$ and tiles $u_1, u_2 \in \mathfrak{P}(X)$, the collection of cubes $\mathcal{J}_5(t, u_1, u_2) \subseteq \mathrm{Grid}(X)$; according to the docstring, this is the collection $\mathcal{J}'$ defined at the start of Section 7.5.1, renamed to distinguish it from the $\mathcal{J}'$ of Section 7.6.

TileStructure.Forest.χ.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space equipped with the standing Carleson data $\mathrm{ProofData}(a, q, K, \sigma_1, \sigma_2, F, G)$ (with $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, a kernel $K : X \times X \to \mathbb{C}$, functions $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$ and sets $F, G \subseteq X$), and with a tile structure $\mathrm{TileStructure}(Q, \mathrm{defaultD}(a), \mathrm{default}\kappa(a), \mathrm{defaultS}(X), \mathrm{cancelPt}(X))$ on $X$, where $Q$ is the function $X \to \Theta(X)$ given by the proof data. Definition: for a natural number $n$, an $n$-forest $t$, tiles $u_1, u_2 \in \mathfrak{P}(X)$, a cube $J \in \mathrm{Grid}(X)$ and a point $x \in X$, the nonnegative real number $\chi_J(x) = \chi(t, u_1, u_2, J, x)$; according to the docstring, this is the function $\chi$ defined in the proof of Lemma 7.5.2.

TileStructure.Forest.holderFunction.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space equipped with the standing Carleson data $\mathrm{ProofData}(a, q, K, \sigma_1, \sigma_2, F, G)$ (with $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, a kernel $K : X \times X \to \mathbb{C}$, functions $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$ and sets $F, G \subseteq X$), and with a tile structure $\mathrm{TileStructure}(Q, \mathrm{defaultD}(a), \mathrm{default}\kappa(a), \mathrm{defaultS}(X), \mathrm{cancelPt}(X))$ on $X$, where $Q$ is the function $X \to \Theta(X)$ given by the proof data. Definition: for a natural number $n$, an $n$-forest $t$, tiles $u_1, u_2 \in \mathfrak{P}(X)$, functions $f_1, f_2 : X \to \mathbb{C}$ and a cube $J \in \mathrm{Grid}(X)$, the function $h_J : X \to \mathbb{C}$, $x \mapsto \mathrm{holderFunction}(t, u_1, u_2, f_1, f_2, J, x)$; according to the docstring, this is the function $h_J$ defined in (the proof of) Section 7.5.2.
